ValidationRule.description: R-GR1: a line names a donor contact or a donor account, never both, which is the person reference rule every entity follows (canonical model Section 4). The other half of that rule, that one of them is filled in, is checked when the batch is posted rather than here: a line exists from the moment the amount is typed, and the donor is often found a moment later, so refusing to save an unfinished line would lose the typing this object exists to keep.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a donor contact or a donor account for this line, not both. A gift has exactly one donor.
